magiseeds.name: Arctic Narcissus
magiseeds.summary: It stubbornly survives in frozen territories.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1You are Resistant to earth and ice damage.
2-3You and your allies present on the scene are Resistant to earth and ice damage.

magiseeds.name: Blazing Chrysanthemum
magiseeds.summary: Its thick petals resemble an erupting volcano.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1-3At the end of your turn, choose earth or fire. Until you use this effect again or this magiseed is no longer in your garden, all damage dealt by you and every ally present on the scene becomes the chosen type, its type cannot change, and it ignores Resistances.

magiseeds.name: Desert Dahlia
magiseeds.summary: A tenacious plant, it doesn’t fear the dryness of dunes.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1You are Resistant to air and fire damage.
2-3You and your allies present on the scene are Resistant to air and fire damage.

magiseeds.name: Golden Ginkgo
magiseeds.summary: Its vibrantly colored leaves represent tenacity.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1At the end of your turn, you and every ally you can see recover from dazed, enraged, and shaken.
2-3At the end of your turn, you and every ally you can see recover an amount of Mind Points equal to (5 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy).

magiseeds.name: Grave Asphodel
magiseeds.summary: Solemn and elegant, it embodies death’s ineluctability.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1At the end of your turn, you may choose an enemy you can see. If you do, that enemy suffers shaken.
2At the end of your turn, every enemy you can see suffers shaken.
3At the end of your turn, you deal an amount of dark damage equal to (15 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy) to each enemy you can see who is suffering from shaken.

magiseeds.name: Hermit Iris
magiseeds.summary: Its leaves carry whispers of ancient knowledge.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1At the end of your turn, choose an enemy you can see. The Game Master reveals its Level, Rank, Species, maximum Hit Points, maximum Mind Points, Traits, Attributes, Defense, and Magic Defense.
2-3At the end of your turn, choose an enemy you can see. The Game Master reveals its Level, Rank, Species, maximum Hit Points, maximum Mind Points, Traits, Attributes, Defense, Magic Defense, and Affinities.

magiseeds.name: Hookleaf Nightshade
magiseeds.summary: Its purplish berries contain a deadly magical venom.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1All damage you deal becomes poison, its type cannot change, and it ignores Immunities and Resistances.
2-3All damage you deal becomes poison, its type cannot change, and it ignores Immunities and Resistances. Additionally, when you deal poison damage for the first time during your turn, you deal extra damage equal to (your Skill Level in Chloromancy) and each creature that lost Hit Points this way suffers poisoned.

magiseeds.name: Horned Hawthorn
magiseeds.summary: Favored by witches and surgeons alike for its purifying properties.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1You are Resistant to dark and poison damage.
2-3You and your allies present on the scene are Resistant to dark and poison damage.

magiseeds.name: Lunar Magnolia
magiseeds.summary: It blooms in the darkest hours of the night.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1-3At the end of your turn, choose ice or light. Until you use this effect again or this magiseed is no longer in your garden, all damage dealt by you and every ally present on the scene becomes the chosen type, its type cannot change, and it ignores Resistances.

magiseeds.name: Ocean Lotus
magiseeds.summary: A graceful symbol of serenity and wisdom.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1You are immune to dazed and slow.
2You treat your Dexterity and Insight as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).
3You and every ally you can see treat your Dexterity and Insight as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).

magiseeds.name: Pilgrim Gazalia
magiseeds.summary: Its flamboyant corolla is synonymous with abundance.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1-2At the end of your turn, choose yourself or another Player Character you can see. The chosen character regains 2 Inventory Points.
3At the end of your turn, you and every other Player Character you can see regain 1 Inventory Point.

magiseeds.name: Prancing Dandelion
magiseeds.summary: A symbol of energy and vivacity, it spreads seeds through stormy winds.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1-3At the end of your turn, choose air or bolt. Until you use this effect again or this magiseed is no longer in your garden, all damage dealt by you and every ally present on the scene becomes the chosen type, its type cannot change, and it ignores Resistances.

magiseeds.name: Regal Protea
magiseeds.summary: A colorful and tenacious flower, favored by an ancient dynasty.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1You are immune to shaken and weak.
2You treat your Might and Willpower as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).
3You and every ally you can see treat your Might and Willpower as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).

magiseeds.name: Remedy Lily
magiseeds.summary: Its elegant flowers filter and purify spiritual energy.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1At the end of your turn, you and every ally you can see recover from poisoned, slow, and weak.
2-3At the end of your turn, you and every ally you can see recover an amount of Hit Points equal to (15 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy).

magiseeds.name: Serrated Rose
magiseeds.summary: Its thorns form a tangle equally breathtaking and dangerous.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1At the end of your turn, you may choose an enemy you can see. If you do, that enemy suffers slow.
2At the end of your turn, every enemy you can see suffers slow.
3At the end of your turn, you deal an amount of physical damage equal to (15 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy) to each enemy you can see who is suffering from slow.

magiseeds.name: Silver Strelitzia
magiseeds.summary: Its silvery blossoms are easily mistaken for jewels.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1You are Resistant to bolt and light damage.
2-3You and your allies present on the scene are Resistant to bolt and light damage.

magiseeds.name: Star Peony
magiseeds.summary: It silently gazes into celestial depths.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1At the end of your turn, you may choose an enemy you can see. If you do, that enemy suffers dazed.
2At the end of your turn, every enemy you can see suffers dazed.
3At the end of your turn, you deal an amount of light damage equal to (15 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy) to each enemy you can see who is suffering from dazed.

magiseeds.name: Striped Orchid
magiseeds.summary: Each segment of this plant is covered in toxins.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1At the end of your turn, you may choose an enemy you can see. If you do, that enemy suffers weak.
2At the end of your turn, every enemy you can see suffers weak.
3At the end of your turn, you deal an amount of poison damage equal to (15 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy) to each enemy you can see who is suffering from weak.

magiseeds.name: Wardwattle
magiseeds.summary: A tangle of robust branches, whose thorns spread powerful poison.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
0-1You are Resistant to physical damage.
2You are Resistant to physical damage. Additionally, after a creature hits you with a melee attack, you deal an amount of physical damage to that creature equal to (5 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy) (after their attack was resolved).
3You are Resistant to physical damage. Additionally, after a creature hits you with a melee attack, you deal an amount of physical damage to that creature equal to (5 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy), and then deal an amount of poison damage to that creature equal to (5 + your Skill Level in Chloromancy) (both these damage instances happen after that creature’s attack was resolved).

magiseeds.name: Wrathful Carnation
magiseeds.summary: Despite their beauty, its yellow flowers emit an irritatingly pungent smell.
magiseeds.description:
⏲Effect
1-4When this magiseed leaves your garden, choose up to one enemy you can see. Until the end of your next turn, when the chosen enemy performs an attack or casts an offensive spell (O), they must include you among the targets of that attack of spell (if able).

At the end of your turn, you may remove this magiseed from your garden; if you do, erase all sections of your Growth Clock.
